---
title: "Archived upstream execution audit"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

Read-only retrieval of bounded project run records from the Iris access node.
This does not run pipelines, traverse sequence trees, or change remote files.
Run with `python scripts/run_python_qmd.py manuscript/upstream_execution_audit.qmd
NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`. An existing destination is refused. The output preserves
the exact selected metadata with SHA256 hashes; software environment declarations
are not automatically interpreted as proof of an installed runtime version.

```{python}
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    raise SystemExit("Expected a new output directory")
destination = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
if destination.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Refusing to overwrite an existing audit")

remote_code = r'''
import base64, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
r = Path('/mnt/isilon/projects/bioinformatics_platform/projects/shared_references/scratch_archives/snarayanasamy/phage_uv_treatment_20260726_full_output/output/PRJEB79569')
records, reports, missing = [], [], []
def metadata(work, output):
    p = r / work / '.snakemake/metadata' / base64.b64encode(output.encode()).decode()
    if not p.is_file():
        missing.append(str(p)); return
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    value = json.loads(raw)
    if value.get('conda_env'):
        value['decoded_conda_env'] = base64.b64decode(value['conda_env']).decode()
    records.append(dict(path=str(p), output=output, work=work,
                        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), metadata=value))
samples = [f'{condition}{phase}{cycle}' for condition in ['C','T']
           for phase in ['I','BF'] for cycle in [1,2,3]]
for omics, tag in [('metagenomics','MG'),('metatranscriptomics','MT')]:
    work = f'{omics}/preprocessing'
    run_dirs = sorted(p for p in (r/work).iterdir() if p.is_dir() and f'__{tag}__ERR' in p.name)
    for d in run_dirs:
        run = d.name
        p = d/'reports'/f'{run}.fastp.json'
        raw = p.read_bytes(); value = json.loads(raw)
        reports.append(dict(path=str(p), run=run, omics=omics,
                            sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                            summary=value['summary'], command=value['command']))
        metadata(work, f'{run}/{run}_R1.processed.fastq.gz')
        if tag == 'MT':
            metadata(work, f'{run}/{run}_R1.processed.rrna_removed.fastq.gz')
            metadata(work, f'{run}/{run}_SE.processed.rrna_removed.fastq.gz')
            metadata('quantification',f'mags_votu/gene_coverage/{omics}/{run}_{omics}.tsv')
        metadata('quantification',f'mags_votu/alignments/{omics}/{run}.{omics}.reads.sorted.bam')
for sample in samples:
    for suffix in ['contig_to_bin.tsv','magscot/MAGScoT.refined.contig_to_bin.out',
                   'metabat2.done','maxbin2.done','semibin.done','vamb.done',
                   'concoct/contig_to_bin.tsv','all_prokaryotic_seqs.fa',
                   'concoct/results_clustering_gt1500.csv',
                   'concoct/split_contigs_len-1000.fa']:
        metadata('binning',f'{sample}/{suffix}')
metadata('binning','semibin_multi_sample/binning.done')
print(json.dumps(dict(archive_root=str(r), records=records, fastp_reports=reports,
                      missing=missing), ensure_ascii=False))
'''
result = subprocess.run(
    ['ssh', '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=15', 'iris-cluster', 'python3', '-'],
    input=remote_code, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=120,
)
audit = json.loads(result.stdout)
audit['retrieved_utc'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
audit['notebook_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
audit['boundary'] = 'Read-only archived evidence; no pipeline execution or changes to analyses'
reports = audit['fastp_reports']
records = audit['records']
by_rule = {}
for row in records:
    by_rule.setdefault(row['metadata']['rule'], []).append(row)
checks = {
    'all_selected_metadata_present': not audit['missing'],
    '12_mg_fastp_reports': sum(x['omics']=='metagenomics' for x in reports)==12,
    '23_mt_fastp_reports': sum(x['omics']=='metatranscriptomics' for x in reports)==23,
    'fastp_133_all_reports': all(x['summary']['fastp_version']=='1.3.3' for x in reports),
    'fastp_length36_adapter_detection': all('--length_required 36' in x['command'] and '--detect_adapter_for_pe' in x['command'] for x in reports),
    '23_gene_coverage_records': len(by_rule.get('bedtools_gene_coverage',[]))==23,
    '12_refinement_records': len(by_rule.get('magscot_bin_refinement',[]))==12,
    '12_six_input_refinement_tables': len(by_rule.get('magscot_contig_to_bin',[]))==12 and all(len(x['metadata']['input'])==6 for x in by_rule.get('magscot_contig_to_bin',[])),
    '12_concoct_1000base_splits': len(by_rule.get('concoct_cut_contigs',[]))==12 and all('-c 1000 -o 0 --merge_last' in x['metadata']['shellcmd'] for x in by_rule.get('concoct_cut_contigs',[])),
    '12_concoct_length1500_runs': len(by_rule.get('concoct',[]))==12 and all(' -l 1500 ' in x['metadata']['shellcmd'] for x in by_rule.get('concoct',[])),
}
audit['checks'] = checks
audit['rule_counts'] = {k:len(v) for k,v in by_rule.items()}
destination.mkdir(parents=True)
(destination/'execution_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(checks=checks, rule_counts=audit['rule_counts'], missing=audit['missing']),indent=2))
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit('Audit has unresolved checks; preserve evidence and investigate')
```
